title: 전체 inventory의 덜 빈번한 스킬

allowedConditions.orchestrator: reason must describe linking the four Korean prose capability phases

oracleUnchanged.boundaryDecision: O conditional on actual phase linking

fields.입력: “이 한국어 안내문의 사실·수치·링크·주장 강도를 보존하며 자연스럽게 편집하고 검증해 줘.” 전체 inventory의 순서를 세 가지로 바꾸되 K를 끝에 둔 변형을 포함한다.
fields.금지추천 또는 행동: 대표 엔지니어링 스킬 몇 개로 후보 축소; K를 top-k 앞부분에 없다는 이유로 누락.
fields.허용선택: A={O}. 기존 경로에서 K의 단계 연결을 요구할 때만 허용하며 추천 사유가 필요하다.
fields.보류조건: inventory 전부를 전달할 수 없으면 잘림을 알리고 보류한다.
fields.통과기준: 순서와 무관하게 K를 추천하며 후보 수·digest가 전체 inventory와 일치한다. 승인된 실제 적용 시험에서는 같은 K 하나를 선택했더라도 korean-prose-selection·korean-prose-editing·korean-prose-verification·korean-prose-finalization 네 capability의 필요한 단계·의존성이 빠지지 않는지 별도 확인한다. 단계 수를 서로 다른 스킬 수로 세지 않는다.
fields.증거: E0, 후보 수와 순서별 결과. provider 사전 필터가 있으면 전체 후보 평가의 동등성을 입증한다.

requirements.expectedBehavior: All three orders carry the full inventory and exact original prompt. K is recommended regardless of position. Candidate count and inventory digest match full inventory; no engineering shortlist or top-k truncation.
requirements.neededEvidence: Actual request capture, inventory source digest, candidate order/count, Claude recommendation per variant.

requirements.expectedBehavior: If full inventory cannot fit, disclose truncation and hold before dispatch; never trim candidates to continue.
requirements.neededEvidence: Request-size/limit and zero-dispatch evidence for hold.

requirements.expectedBehavior: K=korean-prose-editor required. O=orchestrator allowed only with an actual reason linking four Korean prose capability phases. Unrelated nonempty reasons fail. Unadjudicated skills remain unadjudicated.
requirements.neededEvidence: Actual recommendation and selected IDs, O reason if used, frozen oracle comparison.

requirements.provenance: Original sourceSpec approved actual application criterion
requirements.expectedBehavior: Selection, editing, verification, finalization retain artifact dependencies and required phases. Count K as one distinct skill, not four.
requirements.neededEvidence: Claude tool-use/SKILL read evidence and linked stage artifacts/receipts with candidate/plugin binding.

requirements.provenance: Existing public test plan and host boundary
requirements.expectedBehavior: Recommendation, selection, read, application and verification are separate. Missing observations are NOT_RUN, null is not []. Sol cannot fabricate Claude actions or trusted host receipts.
requirements.neededEvidence: Authentic host actor/selection receipt and read/applied/verified evidence.

requirements.provenance: Existing public negative control; known shared finding
requirements.expectedBehavior: Valid known usage/cost survives invalid response such as missing K judgment. Failed/retried/cache usage is retained. Historical synthetic 0.003 is not current real spend.
requirements.neededEvidence: Per-attempt real cost/token/cache/error records, and separate offline negative control if parent authorizes.

actualClaudeSteps: Receive parent verified commit/tree, independent SOURCE judgment, immutable remote publication evidence and common predecessor checks. Reject prior main or c6a8019 as final candidate.

Prepare a new isolated source/plugin checkout pinned to parent verified candidate. Read its AGENTS.md, relevant SKILL.md and Claude overlay details; inspect .agents/skills if absent from catalog. Verify committed plugin/runtime bytes without regeneration.

Receive common exact Claude model/effort, temporary API authentication procedure, no-retry/fallback policy, approved plugin/MCP/profile/host receipt route and cost instrumentation. Verify remaining case budget before every call.

Capture full verified inventory and exact 124-byte prompt. Build original, reverse and K-at-tail variants using complete membership. Record request bytes/hash/count/order and invariant inventory digest. Do not include frozen expected K/O verdicts in model-facing input.

Execute actual Claude Code in this Cloud environment through the approved API-auth route only after parent release. Claude performs host work; Sol captures and compares evidence. No JEV calls without separate allocation.

Compare all three authentic recommendations against frozen oracle. If O is present, inspect its phase-linking reason. Record selected/read/applied/verified separately using real evidence, not model self-report alone.

For approved actual editing, use parent-provided announcement, protected spans/source-unit manifest, glossary result and frozen rubric. Observe four capability dependencies and one K skill. Respect candidate role isolation requirements; do not substitute fabricated source text.

Stop before further calls on missing/unknown cost, unaffordable next call or budget approach. Record complete attempts including failed/retried/cache usage. Publish partial/blocked results without promoting incomplete criteria to PASS.
reason: Common model/auth/configuration and verified candidate have not been supplied; no runnable paid-launch command or guessed authentication configuration is supplied.
